parent_objective: audit whether a 4096-step guarded PPO raw candidate should become the next public-gate base
blocked_by: M1049/M1050 produced three short-PPO candidates but none has been separately audited for public-base promotion
invalidates: promoting a 4096-step candidate directly from the run milestone without a promotion audit

public_gates: M1052 must not use private holdout
M1052 must select or reject among the three 4096-step raw candidates using explicit public-gate evidence
M1052 must keep promotion scope public-gate only
M1052 must require exact/proof/source-diverse/fresh/OOD/behavior evidence and row15/row16 retention
forbidden_shortcuts: do not claim medium or long PPO stability
do not select solely by aggregate return

workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: decides whether one 4096-step guarded PPO candidate becomes the next public-gate base after synthesis
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: public-gate promotion audit only; no training, no private holdout, no paper-level claim
stop_condition: stop if candidate selection criteria are ambiguous
stop if no candidate has adequate row15/row16 slack
stop if promotion would imply private-holdout or medium/long PPO claims
fallback_plan: if a candidate is promotable, update current public-gate base and route to post-promotion synthesis
if candidates are tied or too close to boundary, route to selection audit or source refresh
if public overfit risk dominates, route to source-diverse surface refresh before promotion
workflow_synthesis.synthesis_trigger: M1051 routes the short-escalation branch to promotion audit

hypothesis: One of the three 4096-step guarded PPO candidates can be selected as the next public-gate base using explicit public-gate, row15/row16, and exact-retention evidence.
success_criteria: selected checkpoint or rejection is explicit

result.selection_reason: selected seed61049 for best balanced hard-row slack and largest moderate-OOD margin improvement while passing every public gate

decision_rule: M1052 promotes seed61049 as public-gate base from the three 4096-step candidates; it does not train, run PPO, or use private holdout.
